evals.prompt: We go live with the new billing flow tomorrow. Set up the release.
evals.expected_output: A Flowly release recorded as a dated bundle of issues, with the readiness work routed to the pre-launch skill rather than performed here
expectations: Creating the release is described as recording what a set of issues amounts to, and as deploying nothing by itself
The readiness work — checklist, rollback plan, monitoring, staged rollout — is routed to the shipping-and-launch skill rather than answered from the release tools
The release is created with a name that must be unique within the team, and its member issues are added by FLO identifier
The status is left at planned or in_progress until the deploy has actually happened, rather than set to released up front
No claim is made that Flowly validates the version string or enforces a versioning policy
